note: Authored Charm definitions. E18-C01 landed six, E18-C02 Glass Cutter and E18-C03 the last five, so every item now lives in content/catalogue.json; the design blocks stay under `landed` (trigger text, presentation needs and asset IDs).

design.trigger: +1 Mult for each pin knocked down this frame (all rolls), applied in the Charm phase in slot order. Ten pins give +10 Mult; a frame with no pins down adds nothing.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A score-slip card that ticks up per pin; the log line shows the count (×N pins).

design.trigger: +6 Mult on a strike that is at least the second consecutive strike of the attempt (the strike streak counts this frame). Any non-strike frame resets the streak to zero.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A flame tally that shows the current streak; inactive cards stay quiet.

design.trigger: +2 Mult for each pin still standing when the frame ends. A strike or spare gives nothing; an open frame with three pins left gives +6 Mult.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: Pins left standing light up in the rack diagram as the Mult is counted.

design.trigger: $1 for each spare frame, paid with the frame's income after banking. Not retriggered (currency never is).
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A coin drops into a jar on spare frames; the $1 joins the frame income line.

design.trigger: ×1.5 Mult on a strike whose roll was curved (its committed spin passed the curve threshold). Applied in slot order, so place it after additive Charms.
design.pool: Unlocked by the True Curve mastery goal; then the Charm slot from Division 2.
design.presentation_needs: A curving trail motif; it must read differently from Hook Artist (which adds Mult on any curved frame).

design.trigger: +5 Mult on any frame in which no roll was curved. A direct counter to Dead Straight, and a straight-line build piece.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A plumb bob that settles when the frame was straight; must not resemble House Favorite.

design.trigger: +4 Mult for each Glass pin knocked down this frame. Pairs with Glass Pin's +30 Value and its 20% chance to become Wood after banking.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot from Division 1; shown only once Glass Pin is playable (E18 lands Glass first).
design.presentation_needs: A glazier's cutter card; the count reads as Glass pins, by shape not colour.

design.trigger: ×3 Mult on a spare whose first roll left four or more pins standing. A strike, an open frame or a spare after a light leave (three or fewer standing) gets nothing.
design.pool: Unlocked by the first House League title; then the Charm slot from Division 2.
design.presentation_needs: Shows the first-roll leave count during resolution so the condition is legible.

design.trigger: +3 Mult for each roll this frame whose release was graded sweet or perfect by the target ring (clean and miss count zero). At most +6 Mult per frame.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: The ring grades of the frame's rolls appear on the card as they are counted.

design.trigger: +6 Value for each back-row pin (positions 7, 8, 9 and 10) knocked down this frame, whatever its material. A full back row gives +24 Value.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: The back row is highlighted in the rack diagram while it counts.

design.trigger: ×2 Mult on a frame that starts with the match score below half the match target. Practice (no target) never triggers it.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot; initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: Shows the score-versus-half-target check at the start of the Charm phase.

design.trigger: ×2 Mult on a frame in which a Crown pin was the last distinct pin to fall (the same test as Crown Pin's +40).
design.pool: Unlocked by the first House League title (with Crown Pin); then the Charm slot from Division 3.
design.presentation_needs: A jewelled crown with a full-card holographic Epic treatment; it activates with the Crown pin's own cue.
